semantics.storage: Eight D flip-flops, one per bit
semantics.capture: At each positive edge of clk, if areset is low, q becomes d sampled at that edge
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset: assertion of areset clears q to 8'b00000000 without a clock edge; reset takes priority over capture and keeps q zero while asserted
semantics.hold: Otherwise q retains its previous value; falling clock edges and changes to d do not capture; reset deassertion alone does not capture d
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified before a reset or rising clock event
semantics.latency: Captured value is observable after the nonblocking update of the same rising edge

numeric.data: Eight-bit bit vector copied bit-for-bit from d[7:0] to q[7:0]
numeric.arithmetic: None; no rounding, overflow, saturation, or signed interpretation

verification.method: Independent self-checking directed simulation with explicit stimulus and expected values after update settling
coverage: Asynchronous reset assertion between clock edges
Reset priority at rising clock edges
All 256 data patterns captured on positive edges
Data changes and falling edges preserve stored q
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite compile and simulation timeouts
verification.scope: Development verification only; no official tests, synthesis, or board evidence

specification_ambiguities: Power-up value before the first reset or capture is unspecified; no initialization is added
